auto_accept_layout.trigger_rule: invoke 0x334C510 only when the trigger pointer is non-null; otherwise accept only the scalar bool 0/1

definition_identity.rule: lookup result is accepted only when the canonical key and unsigned 32-bit stable hash both round-trip; runtime ordinal is process-local evidence

character_identity.rule: the lower 24-bit slot index and complete signed int32 generation-bearing CharacterID must both match

preview_output.definition: canonical key, unsigned stable hash, diagnostic runtime ordinal
preview_output.roles: complete signed int32 actor and recipient CharacterIDs
preview_output.can_send: authoritative final validator result; false remains an available preview value

acceptance.ai_final: recipient raw Q100000 plus optional intermediary raw and authoritative outer status 0..2; would_accept_now is exactly status != 2
acceptance.human_pending: known non-applicability; no opponent AI answer is fabricated

steps: capture and validate the requested paused frame
resolve the loaded database, pass it through the exact hash ABI, resolve the allowlisted definition, then round-trip key and hash
resolve actor and recipient through generation-bearing character storage
construct, refresh and finalize one owned two-role context
read final Can Send, signed ten-slot generic costs and final acceptance
repeat the complete native sample and reject any drift
recapture and compare the outer frame before publishing
transaction.failure_atomicity: an unavailable result publishes no definition, roles, costs, acceptance or readiness
transaction.pointer_policy: definition, character and context pointers are transient and never serialized
transaction.negative_value_policy: Can Send false, final rejection and signed negative cost slots are valid observed values, not infrastructure failures

unique_next_integration_entry: wire this private core to the existing application-main paused mailbox and direct guarded native invokers, then obtain one fixed-build paused live preview before considering any public MCP projection
